Test Description: Verify Login page loads successfully
Steps to Execute:
1. Open browser
2. Navigate to https://app.digitalstylist.com
3. Wait for page to fully load
Expected Results:
1. Login page loads successfully
2. CHIC logo is visible at the top
3. "Welcome back" heading is displayed
4. Subtitle "CHIC Concierge: Your Personal Stylist On-Demand" is visible
5. Login form with Email, Password fields, Sign In button are visible
6. "Sign in with Google" button is visible
7. "Don't have an account? Sign up here" link is visible

Test Description: Verify successful login with valid credentials
Steps to Execute:
1. Navigate to Login page
2. Enter valid email in "Email Address" field
3. Enter valid password in "Password" field
4. Click "Sign In" button
Expected Results:
1. Loading indicator appears on Sign In button
2. User is redirected to Dashboard/Home page
3. User is authenticated and session is created

Test Description: Verify Email field accepts valid email format
Steps to Execute:
1. Navigate to Login page
2. Click on "Email Address" input field
3. Type a valid email address
4. Click outside the field (blur)
Expected Results:
1. Email is accepted without any validation error
2. Field retains the entered value
3. No red border or error message appears

Test Description: Verify Password field masks input characters
Steps to Execute:
1. Navigate to Login page
2. Click on "Password" input field
3. Type a password
Expected Results:
1. Characters are masked (shown as dots/bullets)
2. Actual text is not visible in the field
3. Eye/visibility toggle icon is visible on the right

Test Description: Verify Password visibility toggle (Eye icon)
Steps to Execute:
1. Navigate to Login page
2. Enter password in Password field
3. Click the eye icon (👁) on the right side of Password field
4. Click the eye icon again
Expected Results:
1. Initially password is masked (dots)
2. After clicking eye icon: password text becomes visible in plain text
3. Eye icon changes state (e.g., open eye to closed eye)
4. After clicking again: password is masked again

Test Description: Verify brute force protection (Account lockout)
Steps to Execute:
1. Navigate to Login page
2. Enter valid email
3. Enter incorrect password
4. Click "Sign In"
5. Repeat steps 3-4 five or more times
Expected Results:
1. After multiple failed attempts (e.g., 5), account is temporarily locked
2. Appropriate message displayed (e.g., "Too many attempts. Please try again in X minutes")
3. OR CAPTCHA is triggered after multiple failures
Test Data:
Email: bilal@test.com
Password: Wrong1, Wrong2, Wrong3, Wrong4, Wrong5

Test Description: Verify password is not visible in page source/network requests
Steps to Execute:
1. Navigate to Login page
2. Open browser Developer Tools → Network tab
3. Enter email and password
4. Click "Sign In"
5. Inspect the request payload
Expected Results:
1. Password is NOT sent as plain text in URL (query parameter)
2. Request is sent via HTTPS (encrypted)
3. Password is sent in POST body, not GET parameters
4. Password is not visible in browser address bar
